findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (roll call 758)
findings.note: Voted no on second reading of HB 958 (66 to 47). The bill, among many election changes, requires a voter registration application to affirmatively state US citizenship (with a 30-day cure by sworn statement) and sets a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. It also removes deceased voters weekly.
subjects: proof of citizenship to register
non-citizen voting and voter-roll checks
election integrity laws in general

findings.note: Listed as a co-sponsor (not primary) of HB 1246 Safeguarding Elections Act. Among its provisions: makes it a Class 2 misdemeanor to demand citizenship documentation from a voter beyond what State law requires, and keeps voter photo-ID photographs and photocopies of ID confidential. Referred to House Rules on 08/04/2026 (date is the bill's referral date).
